rows.title: AC6 expected output omits four UI steps that the baseline preserves
rows.body:
A `contract` child of #1165.

AC6 expected output omits four UI steps that the baseline preserves
AC6 runs `grep -h '^### [0-9]' mmw-v4/skills/prototype/UI.md | tr '\n' '|'` but expects only steps 2, 3 and 4. The findings baseline says to reorder only Generate radically different variants, Wire them together and Build the floating switcher. It does not delete steps 0, 1, 5 or 6, and What to build requires unnamed sentences to stay byte for byte.

Please correct EXPECT to the full ordered heading line:
`### 0. Prepare the local product|### 1. State the question and pick N|### 2. Wire them together|### 3. Build the floating switcher|### 4. Generate radically different variants|### 5. Hand it over and iterate|### 6. Capture the answer at design freeze|`

The requirement to mount and add the switcher before candidates start still holds. I am continuing the independent text changes without altering the check or the preserved steps.
